evidence: The structure of the films was studied by X-ray diffraction (XRD) and reflection high energy electron diffraction (RHEED) methods. The mass thickness, i.e. the film mass per unit area, and composition were determined from the electron probe microanalysis (EPMA) data. Optical transmission and re ﬂection spectra enabled us to calculate the thickness of the films. A quartz crystal microbalance (QCM) was applied to characterize the film growth in real-time.
